description: Degradation experiments on a SIMULATED timeline. No countermeasure applied.
stage_affected: training/update stage for the main grid and mechanism checks; input stage for the stage comparison

simulated_timeline.rule: flights sorted by payload level plus Gaussian noise (sd 0.8 payload steps, seed 0), cut into equal windows; real chronological order kept within a window. The system retrains at the start of each window on everything it has ingested from earlier windows, then is tested on the current window's flights.

conditions.reference: all earlier flights ingested from the accurate logger A
conditions.stale: A uploads stop after window 1: the model keeps retraining on windows 0-1
conditions.low_quality: cheap feed B logs a growing share of flights (0% in window 0, +15 points per window, max 90%): current x0.88 + N(0, 1.0 A), one checkpoint every 5 s instead of 10 s
conditions.combined: both: A stops after window 1, B keeps flowing

evaluation: each window's flights, clean recordings, P90 decision rule, decision deadline halfway round the route
dose_response_note: keys are feed/B share of training flights; pooled over windows 5-7
stage_comparison_note: model trained on clean windows 0-6, tested on window 7 with degraded live telemetry. Frozen = voltage and current held from 30% of the route. Decisions act on the reported energy used; truth is the clean recording.
